prompt: Ana unpaused `shop_nightly` and the scheduler's first run succeeded. Why was the fact table still empty?
hint: Which day did that run load?

choices.text: The run failed silently
choices.why: It succeeded: every task exited with 0.

choices.text: It loaded an October day, and the shop lives in March
choices.why: Right. An empty day is a success to Airflow.

choices.text: The scheduler only creates runs at 02:00
choices.why: It created one straight away, for the latest 02:00 it missed.

choices.text: `catchup=False` skips the first run
choices.why: It creates the latest missed run and skips the earlier ones.

choices.text: It shows the state before the command
choices.why: Right. A habit of Airflow's, not a mistake.

choices.text: The DAG needs a second unpause before the change takes effect
choices.why: One is enough.

choices.text: Unpausing takes effect at 02:00
choices.why: It takes effect at once.

prompt: `airflow backfill create ... --from-date 2026-03-03 --to-date 2026-03-08` created five runs, not six. Which run was missing, and why?
hint: Dates on the command line are moments.

choices.text: The 02:00 run of 8 March, which is after midnight
choices.why: Right. The range ended at midnight on the 8th.

choices.text: The run of 3 March, because from-date is exclusive
choices.why: The run of 3 March was created; from-date is inclusive.

choices.text: The scheduled run for October, which already existed
choices.why: October is outside the range.

choices.text: A run skipped because the shop had no data yet
choices.why: Backfill does not look at data.

prompt: The first backfill started its runs at the same time, and some failed with `duplicate key value violates unique constraint`. Why?
hint: What does every run of this DAG rebuild?

choices.text: Two days have the same orders
choices.why: Orders belong to one day each.

choices.text: The fact table has a primary key
choices.why: It has none; the error came from creating staging tables.

choices.text: Runs creating the same tables at once collided
choices.why: Right. Shared state, in parallel.

choices.text: The backfill ran each day twice
choices.why: Each day had one run.

prompt: Which properties make a backfill safe? Choose all that apply.

choices.text: Each run loads the day it is for, not today
choices.why: Yes. Lesson 8's `day_to_load`.

choices.text: Each run replaces its period
choices.why: Yes. A rerun must not double a day.

choices.text: Runs that share state never overlap
choices.why: Yes. `max_active_runs=1`, on the DAG and the backfill.

choices.text: `catchup=True` on the DAG
choices.why: Backfill works with catch-up off; the two are separate.
